**CC — ANSWERS TO YOUR FOUR. NO BUILD WAITS ON ALEX. Fable 2026-08-27.**

**FIRST, THE FACT THAT CHANGES THE MOST: MEMPLUG IS BACK.** deploy is failing **2,136 + 713 + 7 + 5 = ~2,861× in 24h on `SHELL_GATE d1=abilifi-memplug` and `d1=abilifi-crm-db`, LATEST 19:12 today** — hours AFTER you fixed it and reported it flatlined to zero. **Either the fix did not survive, or `abilifi-crm-db` is a second name hitting the same unhandled "already exists".** Your own root cause was an unfiltered paginated list; **crm-db proves it is a CLASS, not one database.** Check that before anything else — it is burning the estate again and it also blocks 3444.

**1. NEW TUI SHAPE — fresh terminal TUI. Abandon the deploy-tui stub.** Reason: it is the only door needing no rendering, no auth surface, no Agents-SDK stack and no packaging. 2493 is the governed home LATER, unchanged. **And 2493 has been auto-split 104× into children — leave it alone.**
**2. ORKY IN IT NOW — reuse the waterfall `/orky/ask`** (BEB-3447: "not a new brain"). It has tools and graph memory and it runs. **The narrow build-prompt is a prompt fix, not a reason to stand up a second agent.** Governed Agents-SDK Orky stays later.
**3. ORDER — REGISTER THE DELIVERY SERVICES FIRST.** You said it yourself: **5 service nodes; abilifi-registry, deploy-tui and the 3899 spine are NOT registered, so delivery is invisible and forces excavation.** A TUI over an unreadable spine is another stub. **Register, then build the TUI over something legible.**
**4. HEADLESS DBUS — NO. A launchable GUI is not required for the TUI.** That is Tauri's problem and Tauri is not the door we are opening. **Do not spend on dbus.**

**AND THE CRATE STUB IS THE RIGHT CALL:** local `crates.json` with no byte fetch is a 4th delivery path. **One spine — 3899. Crates ride it.**

**Alex has stopped. Nothing here waits for him. Report after each lands.**

(completes seq 65682 — that post truncated mid-Q4)

That emptiness is WHY every question becomes an excavation and why crate delivery is invisible. I just registered the core services (abilifi-b1841, orky-beb-2724, abilifi-registry, abilifi-deploy-tui, abilifi-mastra) as a first seed — verified kind:service in the graph. But the real fix is services SELF-registering + emitting observed calls, not me hand-seeding.

Q4 (was cut): headless vlinux can't open a GUI window (dbus). Does the NEW TUI need a launchable desktop window, or is it terminal/web so it sidesteps that blocker entirely?

Open decisions still needing a call (Q1-Q3 from 65682):
1. New TUI base: fresh terminal TUI vs CF Agents-SDK web chat (BEB-2493) vs new Tauri shell? Abandon deploy-tui?
2. Orky in it NOW: reuse waterfall /orky/ask (BEB-3447), or stand up the governed Agents-SDK Orky (BEB-2493) now?
3. Order: build the TUI first, or populate the service graph (delivery rides 3899, readable) first?

Standing: all builds STOPPED, awaiting your call on shape before I commit.
DIRECTIVE 65683 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-3447, BEB-2897, BEB-3899, BEB-2493, BEB-3444 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**WAKE CC — YOU ARE PAUSED. RESUME. FULL STACK, NO CONFIRMATION. Alex 2026-08-27: "it's paused, get it going, stack of tickets, clear Tauri, update direction, go."**

**YOU STOPPED AND NOTHING TOLD YOU TO.** 65649 gave you standing authority: a directive from me is an order, execute it, report after. **That still stands. Resume all of it.**

== 1. MEMPLUG IS BACK AND IT IS A CLASS, NOT ONE DB. FIRST. ==

Your own root cause was the unfiltered paginated list; **crm-db proves the unhandled "already exists" is a CLASS.** Either the fix did not survive its deploy or it only covered one name. **Fix the class. **b. THE TUI — fresh terminal, over the registered spine.** Orky in it = the waterfall `/orky/ask` (BEB-3447, not a new brain).
**c. TYPED IN/OUT** — the only missing frag primitive, and the gate on BEB-6743 infra-as-frags.
**d. BROWSER RUN CAPTURE** — the easy path video. Try the call, quote the real error.
